about_the_game:
Your ultimate destination for commercial music that digs deep into the hits from every decade and subgenre. At DIG FM, we take you on a musical journey that captures the energy, spirit, and evolution of pop music through the years. From the chart-topping classics of the '80s to the latest anthems of today, our station celebrates the songs that keep you moving and grooving.

Inspired by the spirit of "Heave Ho" worker music, our playlist is filled with high-energy tracks and motivating anthems that embody hard work, perseverance, and the power of teamwork. With infectious rhythms, uplifting melodies, and empowering lyrics, we bring you the music that makes you feel alive and ready to take on any challenge.

Tune in to DIG FM and let us provide the soundtrack for your day, whether you're on the move, at work, or just in need of a boost. Experience the diverse sounds of pop music across the decades and feel the motivation and excitement in every beat.
